findings.desc: dead code: StoryMetadataProtectionScan interface is exported from doctor.ts (line 743) but has no external consumers — no file outside doctor.ts imports it. Either remove the export or add a comment explaining why it is pre-exported for future use.

quality: grammatically malformed user-facing string at doctor.ts:959 — "  → run `lattice doctor --repair` will be a no-op now" mixes an imperative ("run") with a declarative clause ("will be a no-op now"). Should read "  → `lattice doctor --repair` will be a no-op now" (drop "run") or "  → Running `lattice doctor --repair` will be a no-op now".
